where: blaze-cargo's link of a launched program
what: The launched link handed the launcher's 858 KB to the store as `Written::Bytes` on every build. On a busy Mac a body edit then run was 910 ms at the median (88 to 15331, n=20); naming the bytes the store already keeps (`Written::Kept`) made it 57 ms (54 to 69, n=12).
cost: one full measurement series that measured the store's write, not the path
cause: `Written::Bytes` hashes and puts whatever it is given; nothing says a put of a megabyte is on an edit's path (no span named it until it was looked for)
workaround: the launcher is read once a daemon and put by a program's first build only
state: fixed in 78a3c6731a; open: a span on a unit's puts by bytes, so `blaze slow` names one this size
